title: Detect and normalize out-of-order ingest causing intermittent dropouts in Top Models leaderboard
creator: Ethan Cole
description: Some tenants intermittently see their Top Models leaderboard drop to zero or show a sudden disappearance of high-traffic models for a 5-20 minute window. Root cause hypothesis: out-of-order events from sharded ingest combined with transient retry folding cause aggregator windows to overwrite recent higher-watermark counts with stale low-watermark shards during the hourly aggregation job. This ticket adds lightweight detection, normalization, and mitigation to prevent temporary dropouts from surfacing in console charts and per-model breakdowns.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard smoke test shows no >50% drop in top-10 model counts for synthetic replay of out-of-order shard events
Aggregation pipeline will log detected OOO (out-of-order) overwrite attempts with metrics (counter and sample trace id) for 100% of occurrences
Normalization logic prevents overwrites where incoming shard watermark < persisted watermark unless a candidate reconciliation policy applies
Unit tests cover three OOO patterns: delayed shard replay, duplicate retry fan-in, and DST boundary reorder
End-to-end integration test validates console Top Models view for 24h replay with skewed ingestion windows
implementation_plan: Add watermark field to hourly aggregate documents (if missing) and backfill for last 72 hours in a safe migration step
Instrument aggregator to detect candidate overwrites: if incoming_bucket_max_ts < stored_bucket_max_ts then emit OOO metric and abort overwrite
Implement reconciliation policy: allow overwrite only if incoming_count > stored_count * 1.2 and incoming_source_confidence >= 0.9
Add circuit-breaker metric to temporarily pin aggregates for tenants experiencing >5 OOO signals in 1h
Ship feature flagged behind `ooo_aggregation_guard` and run in monitor-only mode for 48h before enabling active prevention
test_plan: Unit tests for comparator logic and reconciliation rules (edge cases: equal timestamps, equal counts, missing watermark)
Integration test: synthetic multi-shard replay generator that produces: reordered shards, duplicated shards, and delayed shards crossing DST boundary
Load test: run aggregation on synthetic 10k-tenant dataset to validate no significant latency regression (<5% increase)
Dashboard smoke: deploy to staging and run Top Models visual diff against canonical baseline over 72h replay
rollout_plan: Deploy to staging with `ooo_aggregation_guard` monitor-only for 48h
Run synthetic tenant replays and validate metrics and dashboard diffs
Enable active prevention for 10% of tenants (canary) and monitor OOO counter, dashboard drift, and error rates for 72h
Gradually increase to 100% with rollback if customer-facing anomalies increase
Post-deployment: run backfill script for any aggregates left in pinned state and document decisions
notes: Related incidents: incident-2026-01-18 (tenant alpha saw 12m leaderboard gap) - postmortem suggests OOO shard overwrite

We should coordinate with billing team to ensure prevented overwrites don't affect invoicing. Billing already has a conservative ledger that uses raw events, but console aggregator must not remove visible usage.
Estimate conservative: 5 points to allow for backfill complications and adding observability
Discussed trade-offs with product: showing pinned/hazardous aggregates vs smooth auto-correct. Product prefers pinned with annotation for transparency
If reconciliation policy incorrectly inflates counts we must gate behind an additional safety check: do not increase stored_count by more than +50% per hour without cross-shard confirmation
